WHERE fin.IS_DELETE = 0 AND fin.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode} AND fin.`YEAR` = #{year} AND fin.`MONTH` = #{month} AND fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion} AND fin.PRODUCTION_VERSION = #{productionVersion} AND fin.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = #{productTypeCode} AND fin.CONSTRUCTION_STAGE = #{constructionStage} AND fin.BRAND = #{brand} AND fin.PRO_SIZE = #{proSize} AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{materialCode}, '%') AND fin.MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{materialDesc}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC like CONCAT('%', #{mainMaterialDesc}, '%') AND fin.SPECIFICATIONS like CONCAT('%', #{specifications}, '%') AND fin.MAIN_PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{mainPattern}, '%') AND fin.PATTERN like CONCAT('%', #{pattern}, '%') AND fin.STRUCTURE_NAME like CONCAT('%', #{structureName}, '%') AND fin.CX_MACHINE_CODE like CONCAT('%', #{cxMachineCode}, '%') AND IFNULL(fin.LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, fin.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) like CONCAT('%', #{lastMonthPlanVersion}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f5.FACTORY_CODE, f5.MATERIAL_CODE, f5.PRODUCT_STATUS, surplus.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY AS PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY, IFNULL(SUM(fin.DAY_QTY), 0) AS FINISH_QTY FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f5 LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MONTH_SURPLUS surplus ON surplus.FACTORY_CODE = f5.FACTORY_CODE AND surplus.MATERIAL_CODE = f5.MATERIAL_CODE AND surplus.YEAR = f5.YEAR AND surplus.MONTH = f5.MONTH AND surplus.REQUIRE_VERSION = f5.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND surplus.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, FINISH_DATE, IFNULL(SUM(DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) AS DAY_QTY FROM T_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND FINISH_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, FINISH_DATE ) fin ON fin.FACTORY_CODE = f5.FACTORY_CODE AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE = f5.MATERIAL_CODE AND fin.FINISH_DATE >= IFNULL(surplus.STOCK_CAPTURE_DATE, #{startDate}) AND fin.FINISH_DATE <= #{endDate} WHERE f5.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f5.YEAR = #{lastYear} AND f5.MONTH = #{lastMonth} GROUP BY f5.FACTORY_CODE, f5.MATERIAL_CODE, f5.PRODUCT_STATUS, surplus.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY ) calc ON f.FACTORY_CODE = calc.FACTORY_CODE AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = calc.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.PRODUCT_STATUS = calc.PRODUCT_STATUS LEFT JOIN T_MP_FACTORY_PARAM fp ON fp.FACTORY_CODE = f.FACTORY_CODE AND fp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = f.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE AND fp.PARAM_CODE = #{overdueThresholdParamCode} AND fp.IS_DELETE = 0 SET f.LAST_MONTH_OVERDUE_QTY = IFNULL(calc.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY, 0) - IFNULL(calc.FINISH_QTY, 0), f.LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG = CASE WHEN ABS(IFNULL(calc.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY, 0) - IFNULL(calc.FINISH_QTY, 0)) > IFNULL(CAST(IFNULL(fp.PARAM_VALUE, fp.DEFAULE_VALUE) AS SIGNED), 0) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END, f.UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.YEAR = #{currentYear} AND f.MONTH = #{currentMonth}

UPDATE T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f5.FACTORY_CODE, f5.MATERIAL_CODE, f5.PRODUCT_STATUS, surplus.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY AS PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY, IFNULL(SUM(fin.DAY_QTY), 0) AS FINISH_QTY FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL f5 LEFT JOIN T_MDM_MONTH_SURPLUS surplus ON surplus.FACTORY_CODE = f5.FACTORY_CODE AND surplus.MATERIAL_CODE = f5.MATERIAL_CODE AND surplus.YEAR = f5.YEAR AND surplus.MONTH = f5.MONTH AND surplus.REQUIRE_VERSION = f5.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION AND surplus.IS_DELETE = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, FINISH_DATE, IFNULL(SUM(DAY_FINISH_QTY), 0) AS DAY_QTY FROM T_LH_DAY_FINISH_QTY WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND FINISH_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE, MATERIAL_CODE, FINISH_DATE ) fin ON fin.FACTORY_CODE = f5.FACTORY_CODE AND fin.MATERIAL_CODE = f5.MATERIAL_CODE AND fin.FINISH_DATE >= IFNULL(surplus.STOCK_CAPTURE_DATE, #{startDate}) AND fin.FINISH_DATE <= #{endDate} WHERE f5.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f5.YEAR = #{lastYear} AND f5.MONTH = #{lastMonth} GROUP BY f5.FACTORY_CODE, f5.MATERIAL_CODE, f5.PRODUCT_STATUS, surplus.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY ) calc ON f.FACTORY_CODE = calc.FACTORY_CODE AND f.MATERIAL_CODE = calc.MATERIAL_CODE AND f.PRODUCT_STATUS = calc.PRODUCT_STATUS LEFT JOIN T_MP_FACTORY_PARAM fp ON fp.FACTORY_CODE = f.FACTORY_CODE AND fp.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = f.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE AND fp.PARAM_CODE = #{overdueThresholdParamCode} AND fp.IS_DELETE = 0 SET f.LAST_MONTH_VALID_FLAG = CASE WHEN ABS(IFNULL(calc.PLAN_SURPLUS_QTY, 0) - IFNULL(calc.FINISH_QTY, 0)) > IFNULL(CAST(IFNULL(fp.PARAM_VALUE, fp.DEFAULE_VALUE) AS SIGNED), 0) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END, f.UPDATE_TIME = NOW() WHERE f.IS_DELETE = 0 AND f.YEAR = #{currentYear} AND f.MONTH = #{currentMonth}

ANY_VALUE(LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION) AS LAST_MONTH_PLAN_VERSION, ANY_VALUE(PRODUCTION_VERSION) AS PRODUCTION_VERSION FROM T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL WHERE IS_DELETE = 0 AND YEAR = #{currentYear} AND MONTH = #{currentMonth} GROUP BY FACTORY_CODE ) curVer ON curVer.FACTORY_CODE = calc.FACTORY_CODE LEFT JOIN T_MP_MONTH_PLAN_PROD_FINAL exist ON exist.FACTORY_CODE = calc.FACTORY_CODE AND exist.MATERIAL_CODE = calc.MATERIAL_CODE AND IFNULL(exist.PRODUCT_STATUS, '') = IFNULL(calc.PRODUCT_STATUS, '') AND exist.YEAR = #{currentYear} AND exist.MONTH = #{currentMonth} AND exist.IS_DELETE = 0 WHERE exist.ID IS NULL AND calc.OVERDUE_QTY IS NOT NULL AND calc.OVERDUE_QTY <> 0
